account_relogin_row: Log in with a different account
compose_discard_text: The text and attached images will not be saved.
dense_mode_desc: Tightens column gaps, padding and row height to fit more on screen
embed_hide_carded_urls: Hide the URL text when a card is shown
embed_ogp: Show preview cards for other links
embed_section_desc: Show links in posts as cards and thumbnails. Turn off to save data.
hashtags_discard_text: Your changes to the pinned tags have not been saved.
mute_confirm_text: Their posts and notifications will be hidden. You can undo anytime in Settings → Mute.
mute_confirm_text2: Their posts will no longer appear in your timeline. Mutes are stored privately (NIP-51).
nosskey_desc: Encrypts your private key with a passkey (biometrics) using WebAuthn PRF.
nosskey_enroll_failed: Registration failed (no PRF support / cancelled / domain not linked)
nosskey_local_only: Passkey protection can be set while using a local key.
note_delete_text: Publishes a deletion event (kind:5). Relays are not required to honor it, and clients that already have the post may keep showing it. It will disappear from this device.
nwc_via: Pays in-app from your connected wallet (asks every time).
nyan_mode_desc: A just-for-fun cat mode: cat ears on avatars and "nya-ized" text (na → nya). Display-only on this device — your actual posts are never changed.
relogin_text: This switches the current login. Continuing clears locally cached data (timeline history, profiles, etc.). A local key cannot be recovered without its backup (nsec).
sync_save_confirm_text: Publishes two events (settings and deck layout, kind:30078) to your write relays, replacing the previous snapshots.
theme_delete_text: Publishes a deletion event (kind:5). Relays are not required to honor it, and people who already applied the theme keep it. It will disappear from this device.
unreact_text: Publishes a deletion event (kind:5) to remove the reaction. Some relays may not honor deletions.
